verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is built for agents. It documents an HTTP API for reading process guides and working with company context, plus a CLI and an MCP server that share the same process service and hosted records. However, nothing in the evidence claims that the API matches everything the UI can do. The documented OpenAPI contract also returns 404 on both hosts, so the full API surface cannot be verified. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or a capability map, a reachable OpenAPI contract, and hands-on evidence of authenticated API calls covering all operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Read process guides and work with company context over HTTP.
Both connections use the same process service and hosted company records.
The hosted API's input contracts are readable before sign-in
